sources.name: RAM Legacy Stock Assessment Database
sources.role: primary (assessment SSB/TB, B/BMSY, U/UMSY, recruitment, catch)
sources.version_target: v4.66 (Zenodo record 14043031, published 2024-11-06; 'Extended' companion record 14043038 with model fits); freeze exact DOI at Stage 1
sources.license: CC BY 4.0 (Zenodo record metadata seen in WebSearch results 2026-09-09; verify on the record page)
sources.human_action: download the official v4.66 release from Zenodo 14043031, record DOI/version/checksum, confirm the licence text, and re-run src/census/census_ram_v466.py on the official timeseries_values_views (expect identical counts if the mirror is faithful); decide zero-escapement handling and the salmon grouping before Stage 1
sources.stage0_mirror: timeseries_values_views for v4.66 (one preferred series per stock, 35 standard columns + stock/taxonomy metadata) redistributed in github.com/RaphBnrd/RAMLDB_causality (commit 09766f24be1e3ba9d283dfd3fffc201aa4b9dd5d, 2026-06-08; repo licence MIT; upstream CC BY 4.0; Zenodo archive 10.5281/zenodo.20594195). File data/timeseries_clean-v4.66.csv, sha256 c910121955e461599913303bcd945744bc315fd822bbee9d5ef2027da7a70864. Derived extract: not the official DBdata[asmt][v4.66].RData; 4 stocks removed by the mirror author (HADNS, HERR30, HERRNS, SOLEIIIa); 156 SST-only stockids added by a full join and excluded here; the file carries no internal version field (version rests on file names, README and prep script; the 625/432 reference-point counts match the Zenodo record description).

content_v466_from_mirror.year_range: 1800-2024 (1800 is one stock, ATHAL5YZ; next earliest 1872)
content_v466_from_mirror.non_annual_series: 19 pink-salmon SSB series are biennial; 1 rockfish TBbest series is at 2-3-year steps; 100 SSB / 10 TBbest series have internal gaps; all are excluded from origins by the complete-window rule
content_v466_from_mirror.zero_values: 15 SSB stocks contain exact zeros (14 Pacific salmon + URAYVIIde); no zeros or negatives in TBbest/TB
content_v466_from_mirror.census_primary: 457 stocks with >=1 eligible origin, 111 first collapses inside eligible windows, 8921 origins (500 positive / 8421 negative); non-salmon 349 / 92 / 7907 (428 / 7479)
content_v466_from_mirror.verification: independent recomputation by a second agent: all length/coverage counts reproduced exactly; collapse flags differed only through a NaN-after-gap bug in the first agent's code and through row-wise vs stock-level TB/SSB coalescing; the census here uses the label module (src/census/labels.py) with stock-level variable choice
content_v466_from_mirror.official_stock_count_inferred: 1442 (1438 + 4 dropped) - not checkable from the mirror

sources.name: Global Population Dynamics Database (GPDD)
sources.version_target: v2010 (KNB doi:10.5063/F1BZ63Z8); rgpdd bundle used in Stage 0
sources.license: rgpdd package CC0 (verified); KNB record licence not visible in search results — verify on https://knb.ecoinformatics.org/view/doi:10.5063/F1BZ63Z8
sources.raw_redistribution: unverified (685 MainIDs flagged Restricted in the bundle carry no data)
sources.human_action: verify KNB licence and the meaning of the Reliability code (1-5, -1) in the GPDD user guide
sources.caveats: 3615 annual series but only 38 pass provisional screening; effort unknown for harvest series
sources.reliability_code: Higher = more reliable: an IWC summary of the GPDD states that datasets with reliability >= 3 'should be accepted', only ~80 have >= 4, and reliability 2 'is probably too unreliable to be useful' (https://iwc.int/document_1059.download). The Stage 0 filter (>= 2) is therefore in the right direction but lenient; >= 3 leaves 36 series / 5 events.

sources.name: Living Planet Database (public release)
sources.license: LPI Data Use Policy (https://www.livingplanetindex.org/documents/data_agreement.pdf): free use for non-commercial purposes; publications making substantial use of the data must contact the LPI team; derived datasets may only be passed on under the same terms; confidential records (protected species, embargoed data) are excluded from the public release; users must describe intended use before download
sources.human_action: register, accept terms, record the release date and population count; check whether derived labels/partitions may be published (checkpoint 1) | From the official download compute observations per population (X1970..X2020), counts with >=20/25/30/35 non-missing annual values, fullness, and rows citing GPDD / NERC Centre for Population Biology; read LPR2024_Technical_Supplement.pdf and database_stats.pdf (blocked here).

content_published.lpi_2024_index: 34,836 populations of 5,495 species (livingplanetindex.org/lpi); LPR 2024 public release spans 1970-2020 with confidential records removed
content_published.whole_database: almost 42,000 populations of 5,579 species incl. ~18% confidential (database_stats.pdf; Ledger et al. 2023)
content_published.series_length: modal length 6-10 years; >2,000 records at the 2-year minimum; 'more than 2,000' records span 1970 to 2011-2015 (database_stats.pdf Figure 5); Leung et al. 2020 lost 52% of series with a 10-point minimum; 'length' = span between first and last observation and 'fullness' = share of observed years (Toszogyova et al. 2024)
content_published.populations_with_ge30_annual_observation: NOT PUBLISHED; expected a small minority (plausibly low thousands or fewer) and concentrated in a few programmes (BBS, GPDD-sourced records)
content_published.gpdd_overlap: LPI lists the GPDD (Imperial College) among its data sources (about_partners); the number of GPDD-sourced populations is not published and must be counted from the Data_source/Citation field of the download
content_published.collapse_counts: no published count of populations with >=80% declines; Leung et al. 2020: <3% of populations drive the index decline, ~1% in extreme-decline clusters; Daskalova et al. 2020: 15% declined / 18% increased / 67% no net change
content_published.mirrors: public GitHub copies of older LPD releases exist (rlpi LPR2016 CSV; Wolfram LPR2022 dataset) but were deliberately not downloaded: the data-use agreement forbids redistribution

sources.name: BioTIME 2.0
sources.role: primary candidate (species x site assemblage abundances)
sources.human_action: download biotime_v2_metadata_15April25.csv and biotime_v2_query_15April25.rds from Zenodo 15222193; recompute DATA_POINTS/span thresholds for all 708 studies; read per-study LICENSE; derive species x ~96 km2 cell annual series with sample-based rarefaction and count those with >=30 annual observations under one protocol; verify the duration distribution in the GEB full text

content_published.biotime_2_0: 708 studies, 11,989,233 records, 1,603,067 sample events, 553,253 sampling locations, 56,400 taxa; earliest 1874, latest 2023 (Dornelas et al. 2025 GEB 34(5): e70003); Zenodo concept 10932823, latest record 15222193 (v4, 15 April 2025); 16 v1 studies removed
content_published.licence: CC BY for the database plus a per-study LICENSE column; in a 53-study v1 subset: CC-by 36, PDDL 5, ODC-by 4, CC0 3, ODbL 3, CC-by-NC 2
content_published.median_span_unverified: 'median monitoring span 19 years, 12 sampling years' surfaced once in a search synthesis (low confidence; verify in the GEB full text)

sources.stage0_mirror: no public mirror of BioTIME 2.0 data or metadata; a June-2021 v1 metadata export (417 studies, incl. ~8% non-public studies used with permission) in github.com/gndaskalova/GlobalChangeSpace (data/input/bioTIMEMetadataJune2021.csv, sha256 f6e23044ef83043e6a838e7dd34327fb497f6cd2ab83d9e2ff22fdf9c43b169b) was used as a v1 floor; counts independently recomputed and confirmed

content_v1_from_mirror.ge30_sampled_by_taxa: Birds 11, Fish 10, Terrestrial invertebrates 6, Marine invertebrates 5, Terrestrial plants 4
content_v1_from_mirror.fisheries_survey_studies: 64 marine fish studies; ~21 are trawl/groundfish programmes that also underlie FishGlob/ICES/RAM (NS-IBTS, BITS, EVHOE, IGFS, NIGFS, SWC-IBTS, Rockall, DFO Maritimes, NEFSC, Maine inshore)
content_v1_from_mirror.caveats: per-study metadata only (species x site series need the raw query file); DATA_POINTS counts distinct years, not years under constant effort; GRAIN_SQ_KM is 0 for 213 of 417 studies; 17 studies have title year ranges that disagree with metadata years; 2 studies have DATA_POINTS > span
